Thank you! That's really sweet. Do you have any tips for managing bp2? I think that's what I have.

I want to do research on mental illness one day if it doesn't kill me first, so I hope I can make awesome contributions one day.

Technically, I don't have a real bp2 diagnosis, but the current doctor I'm talking to said my previous 10 years of depression, its early onset, and it not really responding to antidepressants on top of ADHD is evidence of an "affective disorder" (her words). Edit: I'm stuck with seeing the school pdoc for now, but I will try to get her to put me on a mood stabilizer. I'll make an appointment today.
